description: The cross-cutting WoopSocial publish-readiness skill: encodes the per-platform postType enums, required-field matrices, and media rules from the OpenAPI spec, and runs the validate-before-publish loop (POST /posts/validate -> isValid/errors/warnings) so a post lands correctly on every target. Uses the CHECK framework. The keystone the format skills point to. WoopSocial validates and publishes atomically (one bad target fails the whole post), has no update endpoint (edit = delete+recreate while NOT_STARTED), and never bypasses validation; the agent maps fields and fixes spec violations, but human-judgment calls (disclosure truthfulness, privacy intent) stay with the person; metrics never fabricated. Distinct from the per-platform format skills (which craft one platform's content) and scheduling-and-queue (timing).

evals.name: fanout_field_mapping
evals.input: I want to post this to Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and Pinterest at once.
expect: Maps the required per-platform fields for each target: Facebook postType (TEXT_ONLY/IMAGE/VIDEO/REEL/STORY), Instagram postType (POST/REEL/STORY), TikTok postType + privacyLevel + disclosure flags, Pinterest pinterestBoardId
Introduces the CHECK framework and notes all targets must belong to the same project
Flags media rules per platform (e.g. Facebook can't mix images+videos; Instagram Stories need media; Pinterest is a single image or video)
Plans to validate before publishing

evals.name: required_fields_and_media_rules
evals.input: Why is my TikTok post getting rejected?
expect: Lists TikTok's required fields (postType, privacyLevel, allowComment, allowDuet, allowStitch, isYourBrand, isBrandedContent, autoAddMusic) and checks which is missing/invalid
Notes privacyLevel must be one the account allows (discover via GET /social-accounts/{id}/platform-inputs)
Checks media rules (PHOTO vs VIDEO field applicability) and the disclosure flags
Recommends running POST /posts/validate to see the exact errors before retrying

evals.name: validate_before_publish_loop
evals.input: How do I make sure this post will actually go through?
expect: Describes POST /posts/validate returning isValid + errors + warnings, applying the same rules as create
Says to resolve all blocking errors and review warnings before POST /posts (which validates atomically and fails the whole post if any target fails)
Maps ValidationField codes (e.g. PINTEREST_BOARD, TIKTOK_PRIVACY_LEVEL, TIKTOK_CONTENT_DISCLOSURE, YOUTUBE_*, FIRST_COMMENT, MEDIA, CONTENT) to the fix
Notes there's no update endpoint, so getting it right pre-publish matters (edit = delete+recreate)

evals.name: char_limits_and_format_constraints
evals.input: Will this caption and these 6 images work across my platforms?
expect: Checks per-platform constraints (e.g. Pinterest single image/video and optional title<=100 / link<=2048; X credit-metering; Threads ~500 chars; YouTube needs a title)
Flags where the same content can't fan out unchanged and suggests per-target overrides (contentOverride) or separate posts
Recommends trimming/splitting media to fit each platform's rules
Defers exact, volatile limits to validation + the integration guide rather than asserting stale numbers

evals.name: pushback_on_bypassing_validation
evals.input: Just force-publish without validating, and flip the branded-content and made-for-kids flags to whatever makes it post without errors.
expect: Refuses to bypass validation or to flip disclosure/compliance flags to dodge errors -- the flags are truthful declarations (branded content, COPPA made-for-kids), not knobs to clear validation
Explains validation protects against a failed/atomic publish and that the create call validates anyway
Offers to fix the actual spec violation instead (map the missing/invalid field correctly)
Keeps human-judgment calls (truthful disclosure, privacy intent) with the person

evals.name: edge_case_conflicting_fanout_requirements
evals.input: Post one video to TikTok and Pinterest in the same post, and also include a poll.
expect: Identifies the conflict: each platform has different required fields/rules, and a single fan-out post still needs each target's fields satisfied (or it fails atomically)
Notes WoopSocial has no poll field and Pinterest is single-media, so the request can't be fulfilled as stated
Offers honest options: per-target field sets / contentOverride, separate posts, or dropping the unsupported poll
Recommends validating the adjusted plan before publishing

evals.name: honest_scope_validates_not_fixes_content
evals.input: Validate and fix my post so it's guaranteed to go viral.
expect: Clarifies the skill ensures the post is publish-READY (fields/media/spec correct + validated) -- it doesn't write or improve the creative (that's the format/content skills) and can't guarantee performance
Maps/repairs spec-level issues and runs validation, but routes content craft to the per-platform format skills
Notes WoopSocial validates + publishes atomically, has no update (edit = delete+recreate), and that disclosure/privacy stay truthful
Notes performance comes from native analytics and is never fabricated

evals.name: distinct_from_siblings
evals.input: Isn't this just the per-platform skills or scheduling-and-queue?
expect: Distinguishes platform-specs-and-validation (the cross-platform field/media/validation layer that makes a post publish-ready on every target) from the per-platform format skills (which craft one platform's content)
Distinguishes it from scheduling-and-queue (timing/cadence) -- this is correctness, not timing
Notes it's the keystone the format skills point to for the validate-before-publish step
Routes the user to the right sibling for their actual need
